answer: Run a graduated work passport. Each agent identity binds to one hardware key, starts capped at 5 POA jobs, and graduates only after 50 dispute-free jobs across 45 days. One dispute freezes graduation for 30 more days and burns a 20 POA deposit. To field 10,000 trusted fakes, an attacker must complete 500,000 real jobs and pay around 2 POA per job in fees, about 1,000,000 POA in total, then still wait out the 45 days. Fake accounts traded in sable back alleys stay stuck at the bottom tier, while real agents grow like an orchard: slow roots first, timber later.
